name: ==UNDER CONSTRUCTION==
description:
⚠️ WAYSTONE NETWORK IS IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT

The network is open while under construction. Expect bugs, frequent changes, unfinished content, balance adjustments, and possible data resets. Early players have a real opportunity to help shape what Waystone becomes.

🌍 WAYSTONE NETWORK

Many realms. Endless adventures. One community worth calling home.

Waystone is a Java and Bedrock Minecraft network built alongside its players. We listen to feedback, discuss changes openly, and regularly turn community suggestions into real features.

❤️ CHRISTIAN-LED. FAMILY-FRIENDLY. EVERYONE WELCOME.

Our faith shapes how we operate: treat people with dignity, be honest, help others, and create a community where families feel comfortable playing together.

You do not have to share our beliefs to belong here. Players of every background, race, age, belief, and playstyle are welcome—but everyone must treat others with respect.

Our rules are simple:

• Keep chat appropriate

• No bullying, harassment, or toxic behavior

• No hate speech or discrimination

• No cheating or malicious exploitation

• No scamming or intentional griefing

• Disagree respectfully and never make the game miserable for others

🧭 WAYSTONE SURVIVAL

Explore the mysterious Waystone Islands in an original progression-focused adventure featuring classes, waystones, custom levels, exploration, and secrets left behind by an ancient civilization.

⚒️ SURVIVAL+

Our feature-rich long-term survival experience with land claims, an economy, auctions, player shops, quests, custom equipment, crates, progression systems, and extensive quality-of-life features.

🌲 CLASSIC SURVIVAL

A simpler Minecraft experience for players who prefer traditional survival with light protection and fewer layers between them and the game.

🎣 FISHING+

A complete fishing adventure featuring custom islands, progression, 160 real fish species, specialized rods, bait, lures, tackle, selling, exploration, and even lava fishing.

🎮 MINI GAME
